purpose: First real-data segmentation baseline, not clinical validation

external.status: exploratory; previously specified QC dataset, not untouched confirmation

split: patient-grouped sha256(seed|patient_id), 60/20/20; no holdout inspection before selected checkpoint frozen
evaluation: run internal holdout once; disc/cup Dice, absolute vCDR error, >0.10 error share, failure counts, expert2 sensitivity, patient bootstrap; external per-camera exploratory metrics
data_use: User requested publicly available data for real training and evaluation. Official metadata licenses reviewed; local computation. No raw data, case identifiers or model weights published.
predeclared_fallback: Only reduce batch_size if GPU out-of-memory before evaluation; record any failed attempt. No outcome-based changes after holdout inspection.
